CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  RETURN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.admin_users WHERE public.admin_users.user_id=auth.uid());
END
$function$
